_doc: Read by scripts/check-sycl-alloc-zone-contract.py (clause e; later clauses add entries). Permanent exemptions only, each with a reason. An entry names its subject (file and function, or a node key), the raw `name` where the code is E-RAW, and an exact `count`; it fails if it matches nothing or covers a different number, and `name` pins the allocator so a swapped-in different call does not ride the exemption. Hand-edited; see README.md.

entries.name: malloc_device
entries.reason: dpct_malloc's one sycl::malloc_device call: rulings M247: dpct/helper.hpp is vendored upstream code and is not edited (rebase churn); the call is dead in-tree, reached only through dpct::device_memory and the dpct_malloc overloads (git grep 2026-10-01). The canonical contract has no row for it (sections 3, 8 and 9.1 checked in S2b), so this pin plus clause (e)'s forbidden dpct names outside dpct/helper.hpp (dpct_malloc, device_memory, global_memory, constant_memory, shared_memory) are what keep it dead
